# GenClass

> GenClass Runtime (`@genclass/runtime`, Apache-2.0, free) is a browser library that runs a 10 MB model on the user's device and reports, with evidence, the timing bugs that never throw: duplicate submits, stale responses landing over newer data, write races, broken relations between fields and failure storms. Observe mode, the default, reports and never changes what the app does. Guard mode (opt-in) can act at the network boundary; heal is experimental. No server, no API key. The optional genclass.dev dashboard is free for 3 apps; the paid plans (Pro, Custom) add history, data export, forwarding and a model trained on the customer's app; the runtime stays free in every plan.

## Shipped
- `@genclass/runtime` 0.2.1 with `@genclass/runtime-model` 0.2.0 (training run r17-v2dT). Default mode observe, default aggressiveness "balanced", report threshold 0.90.
- Install: `npm install @genclass/runtime`, then `import "@genclass/runtime/auto"` as the first line of the entry file. CLI: `npx @genclass/runtime init`. Script tag, first in <head>: `<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@genclass/runtime@0.2.1"></script>` (pin the version: the unversioned URL may serve an older release from the CDN cache).
- Modes: observe (default; changes nothing), guard (opt-in: discard, defer, coalesce, delay), heal (experimental: retry, serve_cached, hedge, rollback, resync).
- Cost: +98 KB of JavaScript on first load; about 13 MB downloaded once at idle on WASM (18 MB on WebGPU), then cached; 190 to 280 MB of memory in a Web Worker while the model is loaded; no device floor by default (`model.loadIf` sets one; `model: false` installs no model and then detects nothing).
- Telemetry: anonymous diagnostics are on by default on public hosts; from runtime 0.2.2 they are off on localhost and private hosts (0.2.1 sent from those too, by mistake); they contain no page text. Opt out: `GenClass.init({ telemetry: false })`, `npx @genclass/runtime init --no-telemetry`, `?genclass=no-telemetry`, localStorage `genclass.telemetry=off`, or Global Privacy Control. https://genclass.dev/docs/telemetry
- Reports are console lines in the end user's browser; the `sinks` option hands each report to the app's own code. Forwarding detections from the genclass.dev collector to Sentry, PostHog, Datadog, Slack or a signed webhook is part of the Pro plan.

## Measured (https://genclass.dev/benchmarks; raw tables in docs/runtime/RESULTS.md and compat/RESULTS.md)
- Model 0.2.0 at the shipped setting (balanced), held-out real apps: detects 75% of duplicate submits, 30% of stale overwrites and 6% of broken state; guard acts on 7.5% of the cases where acting would help.
- False interventions, model 0.2.0, held-out simulated apps: guard 0.005% / 0.13% / 0.54% and heal 0.26% / 0.59% / 1.84% for cautious / balanced / eager (targets 0.1% guard, 0.5% heal: cautious meets both, balanced is slightly over). 0.00% on held-out real apps at every profile.
- Compatibility matrix (runtime 0.1.0-beta.4, the code shipped as 0.2.1; model 0.2.0, balanced; run 2026-10-10): 7 frameworks, 15 data layers, 8 scenarios, 10 seeds, every mode. 350 of 351 cells pass; 0 bugs introduced in 3,510 runs; 0 non-passive actions on correct apps in 1,760 guard and heal runs; guard left 249 of 250 latent-bug runs buggy; observe mode produced 49 false findings in 880 runs on correct apps. https://genclass.dev/docs/compatibility
- Never-worse check: 0 of 396 clean real-app runs changed (66 apps × 6 seeds, always-passive model, v2 runtime as of 0.1.0-alpha.1; not re-run on 0.2.1).
- Six demo apps under network chaos, model 0.2.0, balanced: bug rate 72% with GenClass off, 70% observe, 72% guard, 73% heal. Nothing is healed at the shipped gates.
- Previous model 0.1.0 (r17-v2b), observe mode at report threshold 0.70: 96% detection precision on 16,600 held-out real-app situations, 0.62% false detections on clean traffic. Not re-measured for 0.2.0.
- Model: 8.8M parameters, 10.2 MB q8, about 180 ms per decision on one WASM thread (182 ms for the shipped export), faster on WebGPU.
- Training data: about 17.6M labelled runtime situations, including 837,623 real-browser rows from 158 apps.

## Plans (https://genclass.dev/pricing; source: billing/plans.json)
- Free, US$0: The open-source runtime with every mode: observe, guard and heal; Reports in the browser console; The genclass.dev page scanner (coming next); Dashboard for up to 3 apps; 7 days of dashboard history.
- Pro, US$99 per month (not on sale yet: it opens with runtime 0.3.0, the first version that sends to the dashboard): Everything in Free; Unlimited apps; 1 year of dashboard history; Full data export: every event GenClass received for your apps, as JSONL or CSV, by download or API; Forward detections to Sentry, PostHog, Datadog, Slack or a signed webhook; Interaction analytics (coming next); Email support from mehar@daybot.ca.
- Custom, US$599 per month (not on sale yet: it opens with runtime 0.3.0, the first version that sends to the dashboard): Everything in Pro; A classifier trained for your app: we train a GenClass model on your app's own traffic and bug reports and ship it as a private model your runtime loads; A person from GenClass emails you within 1 business day of purchase to start; Priority support.
- Unlimited apps means no plan limit; one account holds at most 200 apps as an abuse limit. The runtime is free in every plan.
- Need self-hosting, SSO or invoices? Email mehar@daybot.ca. https://genclass.dev/enterprise
